Frequently asked questions

Do you offer 24-hour emergency door opening?

Yes. Our emergency door-opening service is available day and night across Epsom, Ewell West and Worcester Park.

How soon can a locksmith arrive?

Tell us your location and what has happened. We’ll confirm availability and an estimated arrival time when you call.

Can you open a door without a key?

Yes. We use specialist, non-destructive entry techniques to help you regain access. Your locksmith will explain the approach for your door before starting.

Can a faulty lock be repaired rather than replaced?

We assess the lock and explain the repair options. If a replacement is needed, we’ll recommend a suitable lock for your door.

Do you repair uPVC and composite door locks?

Yes. We repair and replace locks, handles and mechanisms on uPVC and composite doors, as well as wooden and aluminium doors.

Should I change the locks when I move home?

Changing the locks gives you control over who has access. We can replace the locks and supply a new set of keys for your home.

Can you secure my property after a break-in?

Yes. We provide emergency boarding up and repairs or replacements for damaged locks to help make your home secure again.

Can you help if I’m locked out of my car?

Yes. We offer vehicle entry, car lock repairs and replacement keys. Share the make, model and year so we can advise on the service you need.

Which areas do you cover?

We serve Epsom, Ewell West and Worcester Park. Share your postcode when you call so we can arrange local help.
